headline: GE HealthCare Integrates AI Features into Handheld Ultrasound
summary: GE HealthCare announced the addition of new artificial intelligence features to its handheld ultrasound medical device line.
why: Medical technology innovations incorporating AI software enhance diagnostic utility and support premium pricing in medical equipment markets.
